map.折射率可以小于 1 吗？: Can the refractive index be less than 1?
map.按 n=c/v，若算得 n<1 说明介质中光速大于真空光速，这违背狭义相对论，通: Since n=c/v, a computed n<1 means light travels faster than in vacuum, which violates special relativity and usually indicates a bad input (wrong units, or mixing group velocity with phase velocity). Ordinary transparent media have n≥1.
map.折射率与波长有关吗？: Does the refractive index depend on wavelength?
map.有关，这就是色散。同一材料对短波（蓝紫光）的折射率通常更大，因此棱镜能把白光分解: Yes, that is dispersion. A material typically has a higher index at short wavelengths (blue-violet), which is why a prism splits white light into a spectrum. Always state the wavelength used; the common reference is n_D for the sodium D line at 589 nm.
